conditions: Confirm the connected-app and OAuth-flow inventory in the org before sign-off
Review Aura components that read custom object fields before Spring '27

sources.title: Refresh Token Idle TTL Is Limited to 30 Days

blindSpots.metadataType: Connected apps and external client apps
blindSpots.check: Setup → App Manager: list connected apps and their OAuth flows

findings.summary: Users cannot see other profile names unless they hold View All Profiles.
findings.evidence: Profiles are outside the retrieved metadata, so which users list profiles is not visible.
findings.action: Assign View All Profiles to admin and integration users that list profiles.

findings.summary: Refresh tokens idle for 30 days expire; existing access tokens are revoked once.
findings.evidence: Integration code is present but connected apps and flows are not visible in the repo.
findings.action: Read the full source to confirm, then review integration call frequency.

findings.summary: Internal fields are filtered from custom object data in Aura action responses.
findings.evidence: 86 Apex methods are exposed to Aura or LWC; which return custom objects was not traced.
findings.action: Audit Aura controllers that return custom object records before Spring '27.

findings.summary: Synchronous heap rises from 6 MB to 10 MB; asynchronous from 12 MB to 25 MB.
findings.evidence: Batch and queueable classes exist; none was found to be heap constrained.
findings.action: No action; useful if any job has hit heap limits.

findings.summary: Apex saved at API versions 9.0–19.0 now produces compiler warnings.
findings.evidence: The oldest Apex API version in the repo is 40.0.

ownerQuestions.question: Which OAuth flow does each integration use, and how often does each one call?
